🚀 aimori | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To prevent accidental leakage of sensitive personal or organizational data into AI chat interfaces by scanning and offering to modify prompts before submission.
✨ Key Features: • Local data scanning: Checks prompts for sensitive data directly in the browser. • Privacy-focused: No server, no account, no telemetry, and no network access. • Broad data type detection: Identifies over 200 types of sensitive data.
📖 Summary: AImori is an open-source browser extension designed to protect sensitive data when interacting with AI websites. It operates locally within the browser, scanning prompts for personal information like bank details, credit card numbers, and PII before they are sent to AI services, offering options to redact or rephrase the content.
